top_choice_rationale: P001 identifies a genuine enabling invention: controlled trapping shifts let confined atoms form an independently realized spectroscopic reference. The Katori-Ye conception/realization scope is more defensible to me than broad precision records or a tally of supporters, although early-priority and independent systematic dossiers remain open. I next favor the focused QSH prediction/realization over DMFT's foundational explanatory framework; both have serious original-credit and discriminating-test questions. The exact-relations proposal is fundamental but leaves a particularly explicit Seifert boundary unresolved. These mature, delimited scientific cases remain preferable to no award on this packet.
recusal_note: No specific personal or institutional connection to the proposed clock nominees is documented in my profile. My PAMELA, Fermi-LAT and XL-Calibur affiliations are other instruments; shared measurement interests do not establish a candidate-specific recusal ground.
